tests.title: POS write path — committed installment sale (RM1,800×4) + tax-rate blocker found/fixed (then cleaned up)

screenshots.caption: POS payment step: Cash + Quarterly plan → Due Today (1/4) RM1,800.00 of RM7,200 (per-installment domain rule) + preferred trainer selected

AFTER FIX: sale committed → receipt/sale-detail. DB verified: sales_order + item + payment + package_instance + 4 installments (RM1,800 ×4: 1 paid, 3 pending). Test data cleaned up afterward — MOVE pristine.

steps: Create tagged test customer (ZZ E2E-TESTCUST @ MOVE KLCC)
POS: member → PERSONAL TRAINING 2X12 (RM7,200) → Quarterly installment → Cash → preferred trainer
FINDING: first Charge & Confirm → recordSale 400 ‘No active tax rate is configured for this organisation.’ — MOVE had 0 tax rates → ALL POS sales blocked
FIX: inserted a 0% default active tax rate (placeholder; client sets real SST)
Retry Charge & Confirm → sale committed, redirected to /sales/{id}
DB verified: sales_order + item + payment + package_instance + installment schedule RM1,800×4 (domain rule ✓)
Commission deferred by design (pos.service.ts:633 — service items earn on appointment delivery, not at sale); trainer assigned to package slot 0
Cleanup: deleted all test rows → baseline restored (0 sales/customers, members 124); tax rate KEPT
tests.notes: CRITICAL HANDOFF FINDING: a freshly-migrated tenant has NO tax rate, and pos.recordSale hard-requires an active tax rate → every POS sale returns 400 until one is configured. Fixed on MOVE with a 0% placeholder (SST0). Recommend seeding a default tax rate during tenant provisioning. Write path + installment schedule fully verified; commission is delivery-deferred (materializes on session/appointment delivery to the assigned trainer).
